mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id, p.workspace_id, p.subject, p.content, TO_CHAR(p.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(p."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, p.status, p.progress, p.archive, TO_CHAR(p.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created FROM projects p LEFT OUTER JOIN project_members pm ON p.project_id = pm.project_id ORDER BY project_id DESC
SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM projects WHERE deleted IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects(project_id, workspace_id, subject, content, start, end, status, progress, archive, created) VALUES (seq_projects.NEXTVAL, #{workspace_id}, #{subject}, #{content}, #{start}, #{end}, #{status}, #{progress}, #{archive}, #{created})
